name: Test (backend-next)

on:
  push:
    branches: [master, develop]
    paths:
      - 'docs/superpowers/compatibility/role/**'
      - 'docs/superpowers/compatibility/backend-inventory/**'
      - 'scripts/backend-contract-inventory*.mjs'
      - 'scripts/**'
      - 'docs/superpowers/compatibility/note/**'
      - 'docs/superpowers/compatibility/remote-user/**'
      - 'scripts/*-contract*.test.mjs'
      - 'docs/superpowers/compatibility/ap-deliver/**'
      - 'packages/backend-next/**'
      - 'packages/backend-upstream/**'
      - 'packages/shared/eslint.config.js'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - '.node-version'
      - '.github/workflows/test-backend-next.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'docs/superpowers/compatibility/role/**'
      - 'docs/superpowers/compatibility/backend-inventory/**'
      - 'scripts/backend-contract-inventory*.mjs'
      - 'scripts/**'
      - 'docs/superpowers/compatibility/note/**'
      - 'docs/superpowers/compatibility/remote-user/**'
      - 'scripts/*-contract*.test.mjs'
      - 'docs/superpowers/compatibility/ap-deliver/**'
      - 'packages/backend-next/**'
      - 'packages/backend-upstream/**'
      - 'packages/shared/eslint.config.js'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - '.node-version'
      - '.github/workflows/test-backend-next.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  contracts:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6.0.10
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter backend-next...
      - run: git diff --exit-code pnpm-lock.yaml
      - name: Backend public contract inventory
        run: node scripts/backend-contract-inventory.mjs --check
      - name: Backend comparison fixture references and contracts
        run: node --test scripts/*-contract*.test.mjs

  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6.0.10
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter backend-next...
      - run: git diff --exit-code pnpm-lock.yaml
      - run: pnpm --filter backend-upstream sync:check
      - run: pnpm --filter backend-next... build
      - run: pnpm --filter backend-next... typecheck
      - run: pnpm --filter backend-next... lint
      - run: pnpm --filter backend-upstream test
      - run: pnpm --filter backend-next test

  integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:18
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: foundation-test-only
          POSTGRES_DB: backend_next_test
        ports: ['55432:5432']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres -d backend_next_test"
          --health-interval 1s --health-timeout 3s --health-retries 30
      redis:
        image: redis:8
        ports: ['56379:6379']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 1s --health-timeout 3s --health-retries 30
      meilisearch:
        image: getmeili/meilisearch:v1.3.4
        env:
          MEILI_NO_ANALYTICS: 'true'
          MEILI_ENV: development
        ports: ['57779:7700']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "curl -f http://localhost:7700/health"
          --health-interval 1s --health-timeout 3s --health-retries 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6.0.10
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter backend-next...
      - run: git diff --exit-code pnpm-lock.yaml
      - run: pnpm --filter backend-next... build
      - run: pnpm --filter backend-next test:integration
      - name: Role HTTP compatibility and failure acceptance
        run: pnpm --filter backend-next test:acceptance

  process:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:18
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: foundation-test-only
          POSTGRES_DB: backend_next_test
        ports: ['55432:5432']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres -d backend_next_test"
          --health-interval 1s --health-timeout 3s --health-retries 30
      redis:
        image: redis:8
        ports: ['56379:6379']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 1s --health-timeout 3s --health-retries 30
      meilisearch:
        image: getmeili/meilisearch:v1.3.4
        env:
          MEILI_NO_ANALYTICS: 'true'
          MEILI_ENV: development
        ports: ['57779:7700']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "curl -f http://localhost:7700/health"
          --health-interval 1s --health-timeout 3s --health-retries 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6.0.10
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter backend-next...
      - run: git diff --exit-code pnpm-lock.yaml
      - run: pnpm --filter backend-next... build
      - run: pnpm --filter backend-next test:process

  # Keep the existing required check name and reject failed, cancelled or skipped lanes.
  foundation:
    needs: [contracts, checks, integration, process]
    if: ${{ always() }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Require every backend-next lane to pass
        env:
          CHECK_RESULTS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: |
          node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
          const jobs = JSON.parse(process.env.CHECK_RESULTS);
          const required = ['contracts', 'checks', 'integration', 'process'];
          if (Object.keys(jobs).length !== required.length || required.some(job => jobs[job]?.result !== 'success')) {
            console.error('backend-next checks did not all succeed', jobs);
            process.exit(1);
          }
          NODE

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:18
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: foundation-test-only
      POSTGRES_DB: backend_next_test
    ports:
      - '127.0.0.1:${BACKEND_NEXT_TEST_DB_PORT:-55432}:5432'
    tmpfs:
      - /var/lib/postgresql
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD-SHELL', 'pg_isready -U postgres -d backend_next_test']
      interval: 1s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 30
  redis:
    image: redis:8
    ports:
      - '127.0.0.1:${BACKEND_NEXT_TEST_REDIS_PORT:-56379}:6379'
    command: ['redis-server', '--save', '', '--appendonly', 'no']
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD', 'redis-cli', 'ping']
      interval: 1s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 30
  meilisearch:
    image: getmeili/meilisearch:v1.3.4
    environment:
      MEILI_NO_ANALYTICS: 'true'
      MEILI_ENV: development
    ports:
      - '127.0.0.1:${BACKEND_NEXT_TEST_MEILI_PORT:-57779}:7700'
    tmpfs:
      - /meili_data
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD', 'curl', '-f', 'http://localhost:7700/health']
      interval: 1s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 30
